text.p: Financial services company Search Capital Group Inc said Monday it named Anthony Dellavechia as president and chief operating officer.
Dellavechia will replace George Evans as president, it said, adding that chief operating officer was a new position.
"Expanding Mr. Dellavechia's responsibilities will allow me to concentrate more on acquisitions and financing transactions," Evans, chairman and chief executive, said.

Dellavechia worked as senior executive vice president, operations director at the company, which engages in the purchasing, financing and servicing of non-prime automobile installment loans, among other things.
